status: Private native source-unit formatting restoration implemented. Public source-language cutover and final combined C/direct/JS verification are not claimed by this report.

scope.input: An authentic successful parseUnit result retained privately by the same open nativeSource instance.
scope.output: An opaque owned formatting input, or an explicit unavailable/native resource result. It is not a checked Program or acceptance result.

restoration.source: Original source bytes, byte length, import rows, line/comment offsets and table contents are retained without composition or rebasing.
restoration.privateState: The implementation retains private M/PS copies independently of public mutable result fields and Program objects.
restoration.nativeAllocation: Existing generic native IR initialization/upload and native symbol/type interners allocate all active storage.
restoration.symbolsAndTypes: Original IDs are asserted while interning in dependency order. Fresh source-symbol and type-key namespaces remain active.
restoration.parserFacts: Genuine scalar facts, including strict profile, parser status and checked-ready flags, are preserved rather than manufactured.
restoration.specDirectory: One rebuilt PS page is both uploaded as M59 and supplied to formatting. PS source and symbol headers refer to the active arena.
restoration.contractWords: Non-empty PS59 contract-token words are captured and reuploaded. Empty parser scratch PS53/PS56 handles are cleared.
restoration.formatting: The existing A0 formatter and revision components consume restored private native state; activation does not call the native checker finish operation.

ownershipAndLifetime.preflight: Closed engines, foreign/refused/cloned units and invalid budgets reject before native mutation. Missing live ports or formatter capability returns unavailable before reset.
ownershipAndLifetime.activation: Successful initialization explicitly invalidates prior current graph/results and formatting inputs, then issues an authentic opaque input for the new generation.
ownershipAndLifetime.invalidation: Subsequent parse, check, activation or close invalidates the formatting input. Copied and foreign objects never acquire its private identity.
ownershipAndLifetime.resourceFailure: A failure after reset returns the native status without issuing a partial formatting input. The retained authentic unit remains available for a later retry or checkUnits.

completedChecks.limit: Host transport and bundled/default-component controls; this command does not execute the explicit C/direct/JS formatter controls.

completedChecks.classification: Deterministic review aid, not runtime proof.

actualCDiscovery.role: Focused correctness discovery with existing unchanged A0 frontend bytes and the current authoring-capable formatter. This is not the final source-bound combined artifact proof.

formatter.origin: Existing C-derived A128 authoring-capable formatting module.

assertions: Exact formatter byte/map and revision equality before reset and after explicit restoration.
Strict profile, CRLF, Unicode import, function/node/return/example/contract comments and file tails survive graph checking and activation.
PS59 contract-token payloads are copied exactly into the active arena.
Public M/PS/Program mutation does not affect the private retained unit.
Foreign, refused and cloned units and invalid budgets reject without replacing the current graph.
Allocation budget zero returns native status 4; retained units can recover and remain usable by checkUnits.
Functionless imported files and nested repeat/example specifications retain byte/map output.
actualCDiscovery.limit: The ignored discovery script uses local artifact locations; durable independent controls are checked into test/source-native-format.controls.ts.

durableControls.matrix: Two activation controls per C/direct/JS backend plus one C native-port payload inspection control.
durableControls.payloadInspection: Asserts new-arena raw source bytes, parsed/spec vector payloads, PS59 words, private scalar facts, empty scratch and namespace mirror, rather than assuming numerical handle IDs must differ.
durableControls.status: Added and typechecked; final source-bound C/direct/JS execution is delegated to the combined verification worktree.

inspected: Private snapshot capture and explicit restoration contract.
PS59 contract-word retention and empty PS53/PS56 scratch handling.
Scalar parser/checker fact preservation and fresh symbol/type namespaces.
Exact PS directory mirror, imports and original byte/line ownership.
Opaque input identity, generation invalidation and close lifecycle.
Shared internUnitTypes extraction and absence of checker/formatter fallbacks.
independentReadOnlyReview.limit: Static review supports the implementation but does not replace actual final component controls.

remaining: Run the final combined source-bound C/direct/JS formatter, A128 authoring and schema control suites on the integrated candidate.
Run the repository full applicable gate before main publication under the existing repository workflow.
Connect production per-file formatting callers in a later public cutover batch; no production mode removal or source migration is part of this patch.
